schemas.name: HushSpec
schemas.description: Agentic compliance as code: portable policy spec for AI agent security controls

schemas.name: HushSpec Decision Receipt
schemas.description: Tamper-evident record of one HushSpec policy evaluation: the policy by content hash, the action, the decision, and the rules that produced it

schemas.name: HushSpec Evaluator Test
schemas.description: Evaluator test suite for a HushSpec policy: cases with an action, a runtime context, and the decision expected of any conformant engine

schemas.name: HushSpec Log Entry
schemas.description: One entry of a hash-linked HushSpec receipt log, as a standalone JSON document; a .jsonl stream holds one of these per line

schemas.name: HushSpec Policy Bundle
schemas.description: Signed attestation over a resolved HushSpec policy: a DSSE envelope carrying an in-toto statement with the policy, its extends chain, and the resolver that produced them
